diagnosis.structuredFieldsEmpty: Every one of subject, action, environment, narrativeRole, requiredElements, avoid, specificity and assetStrategy came back empty on all five beats. Cause found: VIDEO_PLAN_SYSTEM carries TWO schema listings. The new fields were added to the explanatory one at line 1312; the authoritative one - the block that says 'Respond ONLY with JSON' at line 1428 - was never updated and lists only the original fields. The model did exactly what the final contract asked. My error, not the model's.
diagnosis.beat1Contaminated: Beat 1's concept is verbatim the worked example in the prompt: 'A darkened arena stage under coloured lights, drums and a crowd silhouetted in front of it'. The narration matches the example's narration, so this is recitation, not reasoning, and it cannot be counted as evidence either way.
diagnosis.beat5: Spider-Man: the entity was removed but so was the action. 'A city skyline at dusk, with people walking in the foreground' is precisely the static skyline the vision evaluator already refuses. Avoiding the unsourceable name is not the same as preserving what the viewer needs to understand.
